# Carolina Pro Restoration LLC

> 24/7 emergency water damage restoration, mold remediation, crawlspace encapsulation, and licensed reconstruction for Fort Mill, Rock Hill, and York County, SC, plus Charlotte, NC and surrounding areas. One IICRC-certified team handles everything from cleanup to the finished rebuild, with direct insurance billing. Emergency line: (980) 277-3700.

Key facts:

- Phone (24/7 emergency dispatch): (980) 277-3700
- Address: 3650 Centre Circle, Suite I, Fort Mill, SC 29715
- Licensed and insured in SC and NC (SC License #70177448); IICRC-certified technicians; BBB Accredited Business (A+ rating); RIA member; 40+ five-star Google reviews
- Response: 60-minute response goal — trucks reach most of York County and south Charlotte in under an hour
- Insurance: estimates written in Xactimate, direct carrier billing, works directly with adjusters, daily photo and moisture documentation
- Service area: Fort Mill, Rock Hill, Tega Cay, Indian Land, Clover, Lake Wylie, Lancaster, and York, SC; Charlotte, Pineville, Waxhaw, Ballantyne, Matthews, Belmont, Gastonia, Indian Trail, Mint Hill, Monroe, Mount Holly, Stallings, and Weddington, NC

## Emergency & Mitigation Services

- [Water Damage Restoration](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration): 24/7 water extraction and structural drying — truck-mounted extractors (200+ gallons/hour), FLIR thermal imaging, commercial low-grain dehumidifiers, high-speed air movers, daily moisture logging; handles Category 1, 2, and 3 water losses, and rebuilds what gets torn out
- [Storm Damage](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/storm-damage): Fallen trees, roof and wind damage, hail, and storm flooding — emergency tarping and board-up first, then the full structural rebuild, with the insurance claim handled by the same crew
- [Sewage Cleanup](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/sewage-cleanup): Toilet overflows, sewer line backups, and basement sewage — Category 3 (black water) losses treated as the biohazard they are: the area is contained, porous materials the sewage touched are removed, then the space is disinfected, dried, and rebuilt
- [Burst & Frozen Pipe Repair](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/burst-pipe-repair): Frozen and burst supply lines — water extracted, walls and floors dried out, mold growth stopped before it starts, and both the pipe and the damage it caused repaired by one crew
- [Basement Flooding](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/basement-flooding): Standing water from heavy rain, a failed sump pump, a sewer backup, or a burst pipe — pumped out, the structure dried, and torn-out materials rebuilt
- [Mold Removal & Remediation](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/mold-removal): Inspection and testing, containment with plastic sheeting and negative air machines, HEPA vacuuming and air scrubbing, antimicrobial treatment, moisture-source repair, and post-remediation air testing, following IICRC remediation standards
- [Crawlspace Encapsulation](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/crawlspace): Standing water removed, heavy-duty sealed vapor barrier installed, a right-sized dehumidifier added, and existing mold and wood rot treated — for drier air upstairs and lower energy bills
- [Waterproofing](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/waterproofing): Finding where water actually enters and stopping it — interior drains, sump pumps, crawl space sealing, and exterior foundation sealing for wet basements and damp crawl spaces
- [Duct Cleaning](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/duct-cleaning): Removing the dust, pollen, pet dander, and mold sitting in the ductwork behind musty smells and allergy flare-ups — with a free inspection and a quote before any work starts

## Reconstruction & Remodeling

- [Reconstruction & Remodeling](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/reconstruction): Turnkey rebuild after mitigation — drywall, paint, flooring, tile, carpentry, subfloor, siding, and finish work self-performed; plumbing, electrical, and roofing through licensed subcontractors; residential and commercial. One point of contact from demolition through final walkthrough
- [Insurance Reconstruction](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/insurance-reconstruction): Cleanup and rebuild kept under a single claim so nothing falls between two contractors — Xactimate estimates that match adjuster standards, billed directly to the carrier
- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/bathroom-remodeling): Bathrooms rebuilt after a failed supply line, leaking shower pan, or slow vanity drip has rotted the subfloor — and full remodels by choice
- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/kitchen-remodeling): Cabinets, counters, flooring, and finishes rebuilt after a refrigerator supply line, dishwasher failure, or under-sink leak — and standalone kitchen remodels
- [Flooring Installation & Repair](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/flooring-repair): LVP, hardwood, laminate, and tile installation and repair, including subfloor repair and replacement
- [Drywall Repair](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/drywall-repair): Stained ceilings, soft spots, and bubbled seams — damaged board cut out, replaced, and finished so the repair does not show; small patches through full hang, tape, and finish after demolition
- [Interior Painting](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/interior-painting): Walls, ceilings, trim, doors, and cabinets — the last step of a rebuild, and standalone repaints
- [Carpentry & Trim](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/carpentry-trim): The general carpentry structural work requires plus the finish carpentry that makes a repaired room look untouched; also siding and exterior repairs
- [Commercial Restoration](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/commercial-restoration): Offices, retail, multifamily, and commercial facilities restored and rebuilt with minimal downtime across the Charlotte area
- [Decks & Porches](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/decks-and-porches): Deck and porch repair and rebuilds, including emergency response after storm damage

## Service Areas — Water Damage Restoration

- [Service Areas Overview](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/service-areas): Every city served across York and Lancaster Counties, SC and Mecklenburg, Union, and Gaston Counties, NC
- [Fort Mill, SC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-fort-mill-sc): Home base — Dura-PEX failures in Baxter Village, crawlspace moisture in Regent Park and Springfield, and Sugar Creek storm flooding
- [Rock Hill, SC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-rock-hill-sc): Aging plumbing and crawlspace flooding in India Hook, boom-era failures in Manchester Village and Massey, downtown sewer backups
- [Tega Cay, SC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-tega-cay-sc): Peninsula homes with aging plumbing, waterfront humidity damage on Lake Shore and Heron Cove, drainage problems in newer Windhaven and Stonecrest
- [Indian Land, SC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-indian-land-sc): Slab leaks and water heater failures in Sun City Carolina Lakes, new-construction drainage in Bridgemill and Cheswick, infrastructure strain along the Panhandle
- [Clover, SC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-clover-sc): Pre-1980s downtown plumbing, Crowders Creek stormwater flooding, and septic and well backups in rural Clover
- [Lake Wylie, SC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-lake-wylie-sc): Lakefront and cove crawlspace flooding with rising water tables, 1990s–2000s plumbing in Reflection Pointe, runoff and grading issues on the south side
- [Lancaster, SC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-lancaster-sc): New-construction grading in Tree Tops, clay soil and runoff in Edgewater, pre-1980 pipes in Springdale, Cane Creek storm flooding
- [York, SC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-york-sc): Pre-1970s plumbing in the historic downtown district, Turkey Creek stormwater flooding, and rural septic and well backups
- [Charlotte, NC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-charlotte-nc): Aging plumbing and crawlspace flooding in Dilworth, Plaza Midwood and NoDa; Briar Creek and Little Sugar Creek floodplain damage; sewer backups in Cotswold and east Charlotte
- [Pineville, NC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-pineville-nc): 1970s–1980s plumbing along the Pineville-Matthews Road corridor, McAlpine Creek floodplain flooding, and downtown sewer backups
- [Waxhaw, NC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-waxhaw-nc): Builder-grade plumbing failures in Cureton and Providence Downs, runoff and grading on former farmland in Millbridge, Twelve Mile Creek floodplain
- [Ballantyne, NC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-ballantyne-nc): 1990s plumbing reaching end of life in Ballantyne Country Club, McMullen Creek greenway flooding, red-clay grading issues in newer Ardrey Kell subdivisions
- [Matthews, NC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-matthews-nc): 1970s–1980s plumbing in Sardis Forest, crawlspace moisture in Weddington Ridge, Four Mile Creek flooding, polybutylene pipe in pre-1995 downtown homes
- [Belmont, NC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-belmont-nc): 1900s–1940s pipe failures in the historic mill villages, crawlspace moisture and foundation seepage in Catawba Heights, runoff in McLean
- [Gastonia, NC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-gastonia-nc): Century-old drains and sewer lines in the York-Chester Historic District, tired midcentury plumbing in Brookwood and Highland, Catawba and Long Creek flash-flood zones
- [Indian Trail, NC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-indian-trail-nc): Aging supply lines in Sun Valley and Hemby Acres, crawlspace moisture in Country Woods, Goose Creek and Crooked Creek storm flooding
- [Mint Hill, NC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-mint-hill-nc): Aging plumbing along the Lawyers Road corridor, mixed-age plumbing in Bainbridge, Goose Creek watershed flooding, 1990s–2000s supply line failures in Olde Sycamore
- [Monroe, NC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-monroe-nc): Aging pipes in the South Monroe historic district, polybutylene and early CPVC in late-1980s subdivisions, Richardson Creek drainage overflow
- [Mount Holly, NC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-mount-holly-nc): 1920s–1950s pipe corrosion downtown, Mountain Island Lake shoreline flooding and storm surge, crawlspace moisture in Catawba Heights and Woodlawn
- [Stallings, NC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-stallings-nc): Pre-2000 pipes in Stallings Park and Stevens Mill, early CPVC failures in Stonewood, Crooked Creek storm flooding, new-construction defects in Vickery
- [Weddington, NC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration-weddington-nc): Brittle CPVC supply lines in Weddington Heights and Longview, sewer lateral root intrusion in Highgate, Twelvemile Creek drainage overflow

## Service Areas — Mold Removal

- [Mold Removal in Fort Mill, SC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/mold-removal-fort-mill-sc): Black mold in crawl spaces is the most common call here — York County clay holds rainwater against the foundation for days and growth spreads across joists and subfloor
- [Mold Removal in Rock Hill, SC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/mold-removal-rock-hill-sc): Red clay stores water rather than absorbing it, so post-rain saturation migrates into the crawl space — soaked joist insulation is routine in India Hook
- [Mold Removal in Tega Cay, SC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/mold-removal-tega-cay-sc): Lake Wylie humidity keeps indoor RH above the ~60% growth threshold with no leak involved, showing up in lake-facing closets and exterior walls
- [Mold Removal in Indian Land, SC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/mold-removal-indian-land-sc): New construction is the most common call — homes built fast during the Lancaster County boom carry construction-phase moisture that never fully dried
- [Mold Removal in Pineville, NC](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/mold-removal-pineville-nc): Little Sugar and McAlpine Creek tributaries cut through residential Pineville, where roughly 9% of properties carry meaningful flood risk
